biography: Charlotte Poynting's racing journey began not on asphalt, but on the sun-baked dirt tracks of rural New South Wales. Growing up on her family's sheep station, she honed her reflexes navigating dusty paddocks in an old ute, a skill that would later translate surprisingly well to the race track. At age 19, while visiting Sydney, she stumbled upon a local karting event. With a borrowed kart and a raw talent, she stunned seasoned racers, finishing second in her first-ever race. This impromptu debut sparked a fire, leading her to abandon her plans for agricultural college and pursue racing full-time. After several years climbing the ranks of Australian motorsport, she caught the eye of Mobius Autosports. While flashes of brilliance have punctuated her career – a stunning podium finish at Bathurst being a standout – inconsistency has plagued her progress. Now 26, Poynting is determined to prove she has the mental fortitude to match her undeniable speed, aiming to secure a long-term future in the competitive world of international racing.
drivingStyle: Poynting's driving style can be described as aggressive and intuitive. She possesses a remarkable ability to feel the limit of the car, often pushing right to the edge of grip. Her corner entry is usually very quick, sometimes sacrificing mid-corner stability. This 'late-braking' approach can be spectacular, but also leads to mistakes. Tire management is an ongoing area of focus for her, as she tends to overdrive the car early in a stint, causing degradation later on. Under pressure, Poynting can either rise to the occasion with stunning overtakes or crumble with unforced errors, reflecting her inconsistent temperament.

rivalries.reason: A clash of personalities and driving styles. Dubois, known for her calculated precision, views Poynting's aggressive approach as reckless and dangerous, leading to several on-track incidents.
Tanaka, a rising star from Japan, is a direct competitor for a long-term seat at Mobius Autosports. Their battles on track are fierce, often going wheel-to-wheel.
Alvarez, a veteran driver known for his gamesmanship, frequently uses psychological tactics to unsettle Poynting, exploiting her known tendency to crack under pressure.

quirks: Always wears a small, tarnished Australian coin in her race suit pocket for good luck.
Listens to AC/DC at full volume in the garage before every race.
Has a habit of braiding a small section of her hair before qualifying sessions.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about being perfect, it's about being fearless. If you're not pushing the limit, you're not racing."
careerHighlight: Her unexpected podium finish at the Bathurst 1000 in 2022, where she battled through torrential rain and multiple safety cars to secure third place, showcasing her raw talent and adaptability.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the Adelaide 500 in 2023 due to an unforced error, costing her a home-race victory and severely damaging her confidence.
